bullets: The system no longer displays a peak price surcharge badge for Flash models when viewing usage credits, since Flash now uses a flat rate instead.
Verified Y Combinator companies now have a new promotion ready: after collecting $1,000, they will receive a one-time $1,000 credit grant.
Sponsored-v2 capability is now inspected before polling ads in the CLI, allowing a sponsored task to be refused before it starts and re-checked after the consent screen.
An account-wide first-tab discount is introduced that applies a per-user Freebucks reduction on a single session at a time, shared across Desktop and CLI.
The CLI now reports client diagnostics for sponsored runs, capturing user-agent, OS, and capability inspection state for troubleshooting.
Sponsored run offers now use a separate pilot version for the database-focused format instead of the ongoing test's random split between two formats.
